name: Kennl
tagline: The pet health record layer for enterprise veterinary networks
positioning: Kennl unifies scattered pet health data across clinics, insurers, and shelters into one clean, auditable record — so every animal has a single source of truth.

hero.h1: One health record for every pet in your network
hero.sub: Kennl connects your clinics, insurers, and adoption partners so vaccination histories, chart notes, and claims stay in sync — no faxed PDFs, no duplicate charts, no guessing.

features.title: Unified pet timeline
features.description: Merge duplicate charts across locations into one canonical record, complete with visit history, meds, and lab results tied to a single pet ID.

features.title: Claims-ready exports
features.description: Generate insurer-formatted claim packets and pre-auth documents in seconds, pulled straight from the chart your vets already wrote.

features.title: Network-wide alerts
features.description: Flag overdue vaccines, breed-specific risks, and recall notices across your whole roster before the next appointment lands.

features.title: Audit trail by default
features.description: Every edit, merge, and share is logged with who, when, and why — the paper trail your compliance team keeps asking for.

features.title: Open pet-data API
features.description: Sync records with your PIMS, booking tools, and shelter software using webhooks and a documented REST API.

features.title: Usage you can forecast
features.description: Live dashboards break down active records, API calls, and claim exports by clinic so finance never gets a surprise bill.

testimonials.quote: We went from 14 disconnected clinic systems to one record per pet. Our vets stopped re-taking histories, and claim rejections dropped by a third in the first quarter.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: The audit trail alone justified the contract. When an insurer disputes a claim, we pull the exact chart version and every touch in under a minute.
testimonials.name: Marcus Feld

testimonials.quote: Kennl's API let us merge shelter intake records with our clinic charts overnight. Adopted pets now arrive with a full history instead of a blank page.
testimonials.name: Tessa Okonkwo
